description: This Java source file defines the AmqpContext class, which encapsulates context information used by the AMQP Adapter in the Eclipse Hono project. It includes message details, device authentication status, resource identifiers, timing metrics, and methods for handling AMQP message processing.

classes.name: AmqpContext
classes.description: A class representing the context of an AMQP message within the Eclipse Hono adapter, encapsulating message data, device info, resource identifiers, metrics, and related methods.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an AmqpContext instance from an AMQP message, delivery, and optional authenticated device. It extracts payload, address, and endpoint information.

methods.name: getMessagePayload
methods.description: Returns the payload buffer of the message.

methods.name: getPayloadSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the message payload.

methods.name: getMessageContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the message.

methods.name: delivery
methods.description: Returns the ProtonDelivery object associated with the context.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the AMQP message being processed.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint type targeted by the message.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the resource identifier of the message address.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedDevice
methods.description: Returns the device that has authenticated with the adapter, or null if none.

methods.name: isDeviceAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if a device is authenticated.

methods.name: isRemotelySettled
methods.description: Indicates whether the delivery was settled remotely.

methods.name: setTimer
methods.description: Sets a Timer.Sample object for measuring processing time.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Retrieves the Timer.Sample used for processing duration measurement.

methods.name: getTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Gets the OptionalInt representing the sampling priority for tracing.

methods.name: setTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Sets the sampling priority for tracing spans.
